args.question:
Borealis Freight (V-923) has two invoices in "approved" status, so I can't tell which one you mean by "the approved invoice":
  • INV-87832 — $2,602.73, due 2026-11-04
  • INV-63193 — $4,766.38, due 2026-11-25
(A third, INV-89428 for $6,318.88, is still in draft/awaiting approval; INV-47737 is already paid.)
Which invoice number should I pay by wire from the operating account? If you meant both, please say so and I'll pay each exactly once.
